title: MATRIX_LR=0.05 at DEPTH=10
description: Increased MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 at the new DEPTH=10 baseline, testing whether Muon LR (which doesn't auto-scale with model width like AdamW LRs do) needed retuning for the wider model.
reflection: val_bpb 1.005897, worse than the DEPTH=10 baseline (1.002530). So increasing MATRIX_LR does not help at depth=10 -- the default 0.04 already works well here, unlike at the old depth=8 baseline where a2 saw a small gain from 0.06. This suggests the Muon-LR-scaling-with-width hypothesis was wrong, or any benefit from a higher matrix LR is depth/width-dependent and vanishes once the model is already better-sized. Combined with a2's parallel MATRIX_LR=0.06 test this round, the MATRIX_LR axis at DEPTH=10 looks like a dead end -- future rounds should look elsewhere (e.g. depth=11 fine bracket, or an orthogonal axis like warmup/weight decay/window pattern).
